Hero title.title: The art of hospitality, served beautifully.

Hero lead.paragraph: From refined chinaware and precision-crafted cutlery to buffet, bar and service equipment — ONORA brings world-class hospitality products to every table you set.

style.Hero: flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; min-height: 900px; padding: 150px 100px 0px 100px; gap: 64px; overflow: hidden; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.97) 0%, rgba(11,47,98,0.82) 50%, rgba(11,47,98,0.2) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/home-hero-bg.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-color: #071F44; @media(--tablet){ min-height: 0px; padding: 120px 40px 0px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ min-height: 0px; padding: 72px 20px 0px 20px; gap: 48px; }
style.Hero ring large: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 860px; top: 40px; width: 720px; height: 720px; min-width: 720px; @media(--tablet){ display: none; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero ring small: position: absolute; padding: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-width: 1.4px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(201,150,46,0.5); background: transparent; left: 940px; top: 120px; width: 560px; height: 560px; min-width: 560px; @media(--tablet){ display: none; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero content: flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; padding: 0px; width: 760px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; z-index: 2;
style.Hero title: font-size: 104px; line-height: 100px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; @media(--tablet){ font-size: 76px; line-height: 76px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 50px; line-height: 52px; }
style.Hero lead: color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); font-weight: 400; max-width: 560px; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 16px; line-height: 27px; }
style.Hero buttons: padding: 0px; gap: 16px; width: auto; flex-wrap: wrap; @media(--mobile){ width: 100%; }
style.Hero card: position: absolute; right: 100px; top: 300px; width: auto; padding: 16px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; z-index: 2; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); @media(--tablet){ display: none; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero card text: flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 0px; width: 220px; align-items: flex-start;
style.Hero card label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 2.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Hero card title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; line-height: 26px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF;
style.Hero card link: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
style.Stats bar: background-color: #FFFFFF; padding: 34px 48px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px; z-index: 2; max-width: 1240px; @media(--tablet){ padding: 28px 32px; } @media(--mobile){ flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 24px 20px; gap: 24px; }
style.Stat 1: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 20px; align-items: center; @media(--mobile){ width: calc(50% - 12px); }
style.Stat 1 text: flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Stat 1 number: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 44px; line-height: 44px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: var(--on-navy); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 36px; line-height: 38px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 30px; line-height: 32px; }
style.Stat 1 label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-muted); @media(--tablet){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.8px; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; line-height: 15px; }
style.Stat 2: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 20px; align-items: center; @media(--mobile){ width: calc(50% - 12px); }
style.Stat 2 divider: width: 1px; min-width: 1px; height: 56px; padding: 0px; background-color: #E6E0D6; @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Stat 2 text: flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
